snippet.title: COOKING SIMULATOR 2: BETTER TOGETHER | GAMEPLAY TRAILER
snippet.description:
🔥 Step into the kitchen and discover the chaos, creativity, and teamwork of Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together!

Cook solo or team up with friends in a next-generation cooking simulation where coordination, precision, and sometimes total kitchen disaster are all part of the recipe. Prepare dishes using over 200 ingredients, master cooking techniques, design your own meals with the Blueprint System, and serve demanding guests in a living restaurant environment.

👨‍🍳 Key Features:
• Online co-op – run a kitchen together
• Advanced cooking and preparation mechanics
• Create your own dishes and serve them to customers
• Skill and perk progression system
• Expanded plating and presentation options
• Dynamic guest behavior and restaurant management

⭐ Wishlist Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455360/Cooking_Simulator_2_Better_Together/

💬 Join our community and follow development updates:
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/bigcheesestudio
Twitter/X: https://x.com/cookingsim

Let us know in the comments - would you run the kitchen solo or bring backup?
